about.title: How HomeLink works
about.subtitle: HomeLink connects people looking for a home with landlords, agencies and apartment operators across Rwanda.
about.step1Body: Filter by stay length, district, price, amenities and move-in date.
about.step2Body: Put up to three homes side by side and save the ones you like.
about.step3Body: Request a viewing in person or by video. The landlord confirms the time.
about.step4Body: Agree terms with the landlord and sign a written lease. HomeLink does not take a cut of your rent.
about.verifiedBody: A verified badge means our team has checked the landlord's identity. It does not replace seeing the home yourself before you pay.
